pairs.source_zh: 胡光墉（1823—1885 ），字雪岩，安徽绩溪人。
pairs.source_en: Hu Guangyong (1823–1885), known by his courtesy name, Xueyan, was a native of Jixi, Anhui.
pairs.zh: 胡光墉（1823—1885 ），字雪岩，安徽绩溪人。
pairs.en: Hu Guangyong (1823–1885), known by his courtesy name, Xueyan, was a native of Jixi, Anhui.

pairs.source_zh: 作者在书中极力铺陈了主人公的传奇经历，
pairs.source_en: In this novel, the author recounts his protagonist's extraordinary career in rich detail.
pairs.zh: 作者在书中极力铺陈了主人公的传奇经历，
pairs.en: In this novel, the author recounts his protagonist's extraordinary career in rich detail.

pairs.source_zh: 胡雪岩初在钱庄学徒，
pairs.source_en: Hu Xueyan begins as an apprentice in a private bank.
pairs.zh: 胡雪岩初在钱庄学徒，
pairs.en: Hu Xueyan begins as an apprentice in a private bank.

pairs.source_zh: 因囊助潦倒的冗吏王有龄旋升，以致自身失业，
pairs.source_en: After providing financial assistance that helps Wang Youling, an impoverished minor official, advance in his career, Hu loses his own job.
pairs.zh: 因囊助潦倒的冗吏王有龄旋升，以致自身失业，
pairs.en: After providing financial assistance that helps Wang Youling, an impoverished minor official, advance in his career, Hu loses his own job.

pairs.source_zh: 王有龄感其思，遂二人结生死之交。
pairs.source_en: Deeply grateful, Wang forms a bond with him that neither life nor death can break.
pairs.zh: 王有龄感其思，遂二人结生死之交。
pairs.en: Deeply grateful, Wang forms a bond with him that neither life nor death can break.

pairs.source_zh: 后胡雪岩利用王有龄在宫场上的发达，开设钱庄，
pairs.source_en: Later, drawing on Wang's growing influence in official circles, Hu establishes his own bank.
pairs.zh: 后胡雪岩利用王有龄在宫场上的发达，开设钱庄，
pairs.en: Later, drawing on Wang's growing influence in official circles, Hu establishes his own bank.

pairs.source_zh: 在官府势力、漕帮首领和外商买办之间，层层投靠，左右逢源，
pairs.source_en: He cultivates patrons among government officials, leaders of the grain-transport associations, and Chinese intermediaries working for foreign merchants, building connections on every side.
pairs.zh: 在官府势力、漕帮首领和外商买办之间，层层投靠，左右逢源，
pairs.en: He cultivates patrons among government officials, leaders of the grain-transport associations, and Chinese intermediaries working for foreign merchants, building connections on every side.

pairs.source_zh: 以精细的连环计算，收买人民、网罗赌棍、拉拢富商，
pairs.source_en: Through a succession of carefully calculated moves, he buys people's loyalty, recruits gamblers, and courts wealthy merchants.
pairs.zh: 以精细的连环计算，收买人民、网罗赌棍、拉拢富商，
pairs.en: Through a succession of carefully calculated moves, he buys people's loyalty, recruits gamblers, and courts wealthy merchants.

pairs.source_zh: 混迹于勾栏赌场，竭力经营丝茶生意，大做军火勾当。
pairs.source_en: Frequenting brothels and gambling houses, he energetically develops his silk and tea businesses and engages extensively in the arms trade.
pairs.zh: 混迹于勾栏赌场，竭力经营丝茶生意，大做军火勾当。
pairs.en: Frequenting brothels and gambling houses, he energetically develops his silk and tea businesses and engages extensively in the arms trade.

pairs.source_zh: 其问，收姬纳妾，邀友狎妓，不惜重金为妓女赎身，又转手奉送于高官……
pairs.source_en: Meanwhile, he acquires concubines, visits courtesans with his friends, and spends lavishly to buy women out of prostitution, only to present them in turn to high officials...
pairs.zh: 其问，收姬纳妾，邀友狎妓，不惜重金为妓女赎身，又转手奉送于高官……
pairs.en: Meanwhile, he acquires concubines, visits courtesans with his friends, and spends lavishly to buy women out of prostitution, only to present them in turn to high officials...

pairs.source_zh: 由于胡雪岩精于谋划，手段灵活，因此，很快得以暴发，
pairs.source_en: An astute planner with flexible methods, Hu rapidly amasses a fortune.
pairs.zh: 由于胡雪岩精于谋划，手段灵活，因此，很快得以暴发，
pairs.en: An astute planner with flexible methods, Hu rapidly amasses a fortune.

pairs.source_zh: 终至在上海、杭州立足，由市井布衣，跻于江浙大贾之列。
pairs.source_en: He establishes himself in Shanghai and Hangzhou, rising from the ranks of ordinary townspeople to become one of the great merchants of Jiangsu and Zhejiang.
pairs.zh: 终至在上海、杭州立足，由市井布衣，跻于江浙大贾之列。
pairs.en: He establishes himself in Shanghai and Hangzhou, rising from the ranks of ordinary townspeople to become one of the great merchants of Jiangsu and Zhejiang.

pairs.source_zh: 列于《胡雪岩》（上、中、下）之后的《红顶商人》和《灯火楼台》等书（亦为台湾著名作家高阳先生所著，本公司出版），将继续向广大读者展现胡雪岩，这个半封建、半殖民地让会中的特定历史产物如何由商而宫、暴起暴落的曲折激烈的场面。
pairs.source_en: The Red-Topped Merchant and Towers of Light, which follow the three volumes of Hu Xueyan, are also by the celebrated Taiwan-based author Gao Yang and are published by our company. They continue the turbulent story of this figure shaped by a particular historical age: a semi-feudal, semi-colonial society. Readers will see how he moves from commerce into official life, and how his spectacular rise gives way to a dramatic fall.
pairs.zh: 列于《胡雪岩》（上、中、下）之后的《红顶商人》和《灯火楼台》等书（亦为台湾著名作家高阳先生所著，本公司出版），将继续向广大读者展现胡雪岩，这个半封建、半殖民地让会中的特定历史产物如何由商而宫、暴起暴落的曲折激烈的场面。
pairs.en: The Red-Topped Merchant and Towers of Light, which follow the three volumes of Hu Xueyan, are also by the celebrated Taiwan-based author Gao Yang and are published by our company. They continue the turbulent story of this figure shaped by a particular historical age: a semi-feudal, semi-colonial society. Readers will see how he moves from commerce into official life, and how his spectacular rise gives way to a dramatic fall.

pairs.source_zh: 在清朝咸丰七年，英商麦加利银行设分行于上海以前，全国金融事业，为两个集团所掌握，商业上的术语称为“帮”，
pairs.source_en: Before the British Chartered Bank opened a branch in Shanghai in the seventh year of the Xianfeng reign, China's financial business was controlled by two groups, known in commercial usage as bang, or merchant networks.
pairs.zh: 在清朝咸丰七年，英商麦加利银行设分行于上海以前，全国金融事业，为两个集团所掌握，商业上的术语称为“帮”，
pairs.en: Before the British Chartered Bank opened a branch in Shanghai in the seventh year of the Xianfeng reign, China's financial business was controlled by two groups, known in commercial usage as bang, or merchant networks.

pairs.source_zh: 北方是山西帮，南方地宁绍帮，
pairs.source_en: In the north stood the Shanxi network; in the south, the Ningbo–Shaoxing network.
pairs.zh: 北方是山西帮，南方地宁绍帮，
pairs.en: In the north stood the Shanxi network; in the south, the Ningbo–Shaoxing network.

pairs.source_zh: 所业虽同，其名则异，
pairs.source_en: Although they pursued the same line of business, their establishments bore different names.
pairs.zh: 所业虽同，其名则异，
pairs.en: Although they pursued the same line of business, their establishments bore different names.

pairs.source_zh: 大致前者称为“票号”，后者称是“钱庄”。
pairs.source_en: Broadly speaking, those in the north were called piaohao, or remittance banks, while those in the south were known as qianzhuang, or private banks.
pairs.zh: 大致前者称为“票号”，后者称是“钱庄”。
pairs.en: Broadly speaking, those in the north were called piaohao, or remittance banks, while those in the south were known as qianzhuang, or private banks.

pairs.source_zh: 山西帮又分为祁、太，平三帮，祁县、太谷、平遥，
pairs.source_en: The Shanxi network was itself divided into three groups, based in Qixian, Taigu, and Pingyao.
pairs.zh: 山西帮又分为祁、太，平三帮，祁县、太谷、平遥，
pairs.en: The Shanxi network was itself divided into three groups, based in Qixian, Taigu, and Pingyao.

pairs.source_zh: 而始创票号者，为平遥人雷履泰。
pairs.source_en: The founder of the remittance-bank business was Lei Lütai, a native of Pingyao.
pairs.zh: 而始创票号者，为平遥人雷履泰。
pairs.en: The founder of the remittance-bank business was Lei Lütai, a native of Pingyao.

pairs.source_zh: 他最初受雇于同县李姓，在天津主持一定颜料铺，招牌叫做“日升昌”，
pairs.source_en: He had originally been employed by a man surnamed Li from the same county to manage a pigment shop in Tianjin called Rishengchang.
pairs.zh: 他最初受雇于同县李姓，在天津主持一定颜料铺，招牌叫做“日升昌”，
pairs.en: He had originally been employed by a man surnamed Li from the same county to manage a pigment shop in Tianjin called Rishengchang.

pairs.source_zh: 其时大约在乾隆末年。
pairs.source_en: This was around the end of the Qianlong reign.
pairs.zh: 其时大约在乾隆末年。
pairs.en: This was around the end of the Qianlong reign.

pairs.source_zh: 日升昌在雷履泰的悉心照料之下，营业日盛，声誉日起，
pairs.source_en: Under Lei's careful management, the business prospered and its reputation grew.
pairs.zh: 日升昌在雷履泰的悉心照料之下，营业日盛，声誉日起，
pairs.en: Under Lei's careful management, the business prospered and its reputation grew.

pairs.source_zh: 连四川都知道这块“金字招牌”，因为雷履泰经常入川采购铜绿等等颜料，信用极好。
pairs.source_en: Its name became a guarantee of quality known even in Sichuan, where Lei frequently purchased verdigris and other pigments and enjoyed an excellent reputation for reliability.
pairs.zh: 连四川都知道这块“金字招牌”，因为雷履泰经常入川采购铜绿等等颜料，信用极好。
pairs.en: Its name became a guarantee of quality known even in Sichuan, where Lei frequently purchased verdigris and other pigments and enjoyed an excellent reputation for reliability.

pairs.source_zh: 四川与他省的交通最不便，
pairs.source_en: Travel between Sichuan and the other provinces was particularly difficult.
pairs.zh: 四川与他省的交通最不便，
pairs.en: Travel between Sichuan and the other provinces was particularly difficult.

pairs.source_zh: 出川入川携带大批现金，不但麻烦，而且有风险。
pairs.source_en: Carrying large amounts of cash into or out of the province was not only inconvenient but also dangerous.
pairs.zh: 出川入川携带大批现金，不但麻烦，而且有风险。
pairs.en: Carrying large amounts of cash into or out of the province was not only inconvenient but also dangerous.

pairs.source_zh: 于是雷履泰创行汇兑法，由日升昌收银出票，凭票到指走地点的联号兑取现银。
pairs.source_en: Lei therefore introduced a system of remittance: Rishengchang accepted silver and issued a draft that could be exchanged for silver at an affiliated establishment in a designated location.
pairs.zh: 于是雷履泰创行汇兑法，由日升昌收银出票，凭票到指走地点的联号兑取现银。
pairs.en: Lei therefore introduced a system of remittance: Rishengchang accepted silver and issued a draft that could be exchanged for silver at an affiliated establishment in a designated location.

pairs.source_zh: 当然，汇兑要收汇费，名为“汇水”。
pairs.source_en: A remittance fee, known as huishui, was naturally charged.
pairs.zh: 当然，汇兑要收汇费，名为“汇水”。
pairs.en: A remittance fee, known as huishui, was naturally charged.

pairs.source_zh: 汇水并无定额，是根据三个因素计算出来的：
pairs.source_en: The fee was not fixed but depended on three factors.
pairs.zh: 汇水并无定额，是根据三个因素计算出来的：
pairs.en: The fee was not fixed but depended on three factors.

pairs.source_zh: 第一，路途的远近，远则贵，近则廉。
pairs.source_en: The first was distance: the farther the destination, the higher the charge.
pairs.zh: 第一，路途的远近，远则贵，近则廉。
pairs.en: The first was distance: the farther the destination, the higher the charge.

pairs.source_zh: 第二，银根的松紧，
pairs.source_en: The second was the availability of ready money.
pairs.zh: 第二，银根的松紧，
pairs.en: The second was the availability of ready money.

pairs.source_zh: 大致由小地方汇到大地方来得便宜，由大地方汇到小地方来得贵，因为地方大则银根松，地方小则银根紧，
pairs.source_en: As a rule, it cost less to remit funds from a small town to a large city than in the opposite direction, since ready money was more plentiful in larger places and scarcer in smaller ones.
pairs.zh: 大致由小地方汇到大地方来得便宜，由大地方汇到小地方来得贵，因为地方大则银根松，地方小则银根紧，
pairs.en: As a rule, it cost less to remit funds from a small town to a large city than in the opposite direction, since ready money was more plentiful in larger places and scarcer in smaller ones.

pairs.source_zh: 如某处缺乏现金，而有待兑的汇票，则此时有客户交汇，正好济急，
pairs.source_en: If a branch was short of cash and had outstanding drafts to redeem, a customer bringing in silver for remittance would provide much-needed relief.
pairs.zh: 如某处缺乏现金，而有待兑的汇票，则此时有客户交汇，正好济急，
pairs.en: If a branch was short of cash and had outstanding drafts to redeem, a customer bringing in silver for remittance would provide much-needed relief.

pairs.source_zh: 反有倒过来贴补客户汇费的。
pairs.source_en: In such cases, the bank might even pay the customer a premium instead of charging a fee.
pairs.zh: 反有倒过来贴补客户汇费的。
pairs.en: In such cases, the bank might even pay the customer a premium instead of charging a fee.

pairs.source_zh: 最后是计算银锭的成色，
pairs.source_en: The final consideration was the purity of the silver ingots.
pairs.zh: 最后是计算银锭的成色，
pairs.en: The final consideration was the purity of the silver ingots.

pairs.source_zh: 银锭的大小，通常分为三种，
pairs.source_en: Ingots generally came in three sizes.
pairs.zh: 银锭的大小，通常分为三种，
pairs.en: Ingots generally came in three sizes.

pairs.source_zh: 最大的五十两，为了便于双手携捧，做成两头翘起的马蹄式，
pairs.source_en: The largest weighed fifty taels and were shaped like a horseshoe with raised ends, making them easier to lift with both hands.
pairs.zh: 最大的五十两，为了便于双手携捧，做成两头翘起的马蹄式，
pairs.en: The largest weighed fifty taels and were shaped like a horseshoe with raised ends, making them easier to lift with both hands.

pairs.source_zh: 即所谓“元宝”，而出于各省藩库的，称为“官宝”，
pairs.source_en: These were the ingots known as yuanbao; those issued by provincial treasuries were called official ingots.
pairs.zh: 即所谓“元宝”，而出于各省藩库的，称为“官宝”，
pairs.en: These were the ingots known as yuanbao; those issued by provincial treasuries were called official ingots.

pairs.source_zh: 其次是中锭，重十两，
pairs.source_en: Medium-sized ingots weighed ten taels.
pairs.zh: 其次是中锭，重十两，
pairs.en: Medium-sized ingots weighed ten taels.

pairs.source_zh: 有元宝形的，称为“小元宝”，但通常都做成秤锤式，
pairs.source_en: Some resembled the larger yuanbao and were called small yuanbao, though most were shaped like scale weights.
pairs.zh: 有元宝形的，称为“小元宝”，但通常都做成秤锤式，
pairs.en: Some resembled the larger yuanbao and were called small yuanbao, though most were shaped like scale weights.

pairs.source_zh: 最小的或三两，或五两，通称“银锞”。
pairs.source_en: The smallest weighed three or five taels and were commonly called silver lumps.
pairs.zh: 最小的或三两，或五两，通称“银锞”。
pairs.en: The smallest weighed three or five taels and were commonly called silver lumps.

pairs.source_zh: 再就是碎银，轻重不等。
pairs.source_en: There was also broken silver, which varied in weight.
pairs.zh: 再就是碎银，轻重不等。
pairs.en: There was also broken silver, which varied in weight.

pairs.source_zh: 此外各省有其特殊的形制，
pairs.source_en: Each province had its own distinctive forms.
pairs.zh: 此外各省有其特殊的形制，
pairs.en: Each province had its own distinctive forms.

pairs.source_zh: 如江浙称为“元丝”，底凹上凸，以便叠置。
pairs.source_en: In Jiangsu and Zhejiang, for example, the ingots known as yuansi had concave bases and convex tops so that they could be stacked.
pairs.zh: 如江浙称为“元丝”，底凹上凸，以便叠置。
pairs.en: In Jiangsu and Zhejiang, for example, the ingots known as yuansi had concave bases and convex tops so that they could be stacked.

pairs.source_zh: 但不管任何形状、大小，银子的成色，各地不同，
pairs.source_en: Whatever their shape or size, however, the purity of silver differed from place to place.
pairs.zh: 但不管任何形状、大小，银子的成色，各地不同，
pairs.en: Whatever their shape or size, however, the purity of silver differed from place to place.

pairs.source_zh: 需要在交汇时核算扣足。
pairs.source_en: These differences had to be calculated and fully allowed for when a remittance was made.
pairs.zh: 需要在交汇时核算扣足。
pairs.en: These differences had to be calculated and fully allowed for when a remittance was made.

pairs.source_zh: 由于汇兑凭票兑银，所以叫做“票号”。
pairs.source_en: Since silver was paid out against a draft, these establishments came to be called piaohao, literally “draft houses.”
pairs.zh: 由于汇兑凭票兑银，所以叫做“票号”。
pairs.en: Since silver was paid out against a draft, these establishments came to be called piaohao, literally “draft houses.”

pairs.source_zh: 早先运送现银的方法，如果不是随身携带，就得交镖局保送，
pairs.source_en: Previously, anyone wishing to move silver had either to carry it personally or entrust it to an armed escort agency.
pairs.zh: 早先运送现银的方法，如果不是随身携带，就得交镖局保送，
pairs.en: Previously, anyone wishing to move silver had either to carry it personally or entrust it to an armed escort agency.

pairs.source_zh: 费用大，麻烦多，走得慢，而且还有风险，
pairs.source_en: The latter option was expensive, troublesome, and slow, and it still involved risk.
pairs.zh: 费用大，麻烦多，走得慢，而且还有风险，
pairs.en: The latter option was expensive, troublesome, and slow, and it still involved risk.

pairs.source_zh: 万一被动或者出了其他意外，镖局虽然照赔，但总是件不愉快的事，
pairs.source_en: If the silver was stolen or some other mishap occurred, the escort agency would reimburse the loss, but the experience was unpleasant nonetheless.
pairs.zh: 万一被动或者出了其他意外，镖局虽然照赔，但总是件不愉快的事，
pairs.en: If the silver was stolen or some other mishap occurred, the escort agency would reimburse the loss, but the experience was unpleasant nonetheless.

pairs.source_zh: 所以票号一出，请教走镖英雄好汉的人就少了。
pairs.source_en: Once remittance banks appeared, fewer people had occasion to seek the services of those valiant escorts.
pairs.zh: 所以票号一出，请教走镖英雄好汉的人就少了。
pairs.en: Once remittance banks appeared, fewer people had occasion to seek the services of those valiant escorts.

pairs.source_zh: 早期的票号，多为大商号兼营的副业，
pairs.source_en: The earliest remittance banks were mostly side businesses run by large trading firms.
pairs.zh: 早期的票号，多为大商号兼营的副业，
pairs.en: The earliest remittance banks were mostly side businesses run by large trading firms.

pairs.source_zh: 到咸丰初年，始有大量专营的票号出现。
pairs.source_en: Only in the early years of the Xianfeng reign did establishments devoted exclusively to remittance begin to appear in considerable numbers.
pairs.zh: 到咸丰初年，始有大量专营的票号出现。
pairs.en: Only in the early years of the Xianfeng reign did establishments devoted exclusively to remittance begin to appear in considerable numbers.

pairs.source_zh: 但票号的势力不得越长江而南，
pairs.source_en: Their influence, however, did not extend south of the Yangtze.
pairs.zh: 但票号的势力不得越长江而南，
pairs.en: Their influence, however, did not extend south of the Yangtze.

pairs.source_zh: 因为江南的钱庄，为保护本身的利益，一方面仿照票号的成例，开办汇兑业务，一方面力拒票号的侵入。
pairs.source_en: To protect their own interests, the private banks of the lower Yangtze region copied the remittance system while firmly resisting the northern banks' expansion.
pairs.zh: 因为江南的钱庄，为保护本身的利益，一方面仿照票号的成例，开办汇兑业务，一方面力拒票号的侵入。
pairs.en: To protect their own interests, the private banks of the lower Yangtze region copied the remittance system while firmly resisting the northern banks' expansion.

pairs.source_zh: 至于票号除汇兑以外，以后亦经营存款及放款，
pairs.source_en: The remittance banks, in turn, later began accepting deposits and making loans.
pairs.zh: 至于票号除汇兑以外，以后亦经营存款及放款，
pairs.en: The remittance banks, in turn, later began accepting deposits and making loans.

pairs.source_zh: 所以票号与钱庄的业务，由于彼此仿效的结果，几乎完全相同，只是在规模上，钱庄逊于票号而已。
pairs.source_en: Through this process of mutual imitation, the two types of bank came to conduct almost identical business, although private banks generally remained smaller.
pairs.zh: 所以票号与钱庄的业务，由于彼此仿效的结果，几乎完全相同，只是在规模上，钱庄逊于票号而已。
pairs.en: Through this process of mutual imitation, the two types of bank came to conduct almost identical business, although private banks generally remained smaller.

pairs.source_zh: 钱庄业多为宁绍帮所经营，而镇江帮有后来居上之势。
pairs.source_en: Most private banks were operated by the Ningbo–Shaoxing network, though the Zhenjiang network was beginning to catch up and overtake it.
pairs.zh: 钱庄业多为宁绍帮所经营，而镇江帮有后来居上之势。
pairs.en: Most private banks were operated by the Ningbo–Shaoxing network, though the Zhenjiang network was beginning to catch up and overtake it.

pairs.source_zh: 但在同治到光绪初年，全国最大的一家钱庄，规模凌驾票号而上之，
pairs.source_en: Yet from the Tongzhi reign into the early years of Guangxu, the largest private bank in China surpassed even the remittance banks in scale.
pairs.zh: 但在同治到光绪初年，全国最大的一家钱庄，规模凌驾票号而上之，
pairs.en: Yet from the Tongzhi reign into the early years of Guangxu, the largest private bank in China surpassed even the remittance banks in scale.

pairs.source_zh: 同时他的主人亦不属于宁绍帮，
pairs.source_en: Its proprietor did not belong to the Ningbo–Shaoxing network either.
pairs.zh: 同时他的主人亦不属于宁绍帮，
pairs.en: Its proprietor did not belong to the Ningbo–Shaoxing network either.

pairs.source_zh: 是为当时金融业中的一个特例。
pairs.source_en: It was an exception in the financial world of its time.
pairs.zh: 是为当时金融业中的一个特例。
pairs.en: It was an exception in the financial world of its time.

pairs.source_zh: 这家钱庄的字号叫“阜康”，
pairs.source_en: The bank was called Fukang.
pairs.zh: 这家钱庄的字号叫“阜康”，
pairs.en: The bank was called Fukang.

pairs.source_zh: 它的主人是杭州人。
pairs.source_en: Its proprietor was a man from Hangzhou.
pairs.zh: 它的主人是杭州人。
pairs.en: Its proprietor was a man from Hangzhou.

pairs.source_zh: 胡雪岩全传——平步青云（上）
pairs.source_en: The Complete Story of Hu Xueyan — A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I
pairs.zh: 胡雪岩全传——平步青云（上）
pairs.en: The Complete Story of Hu Xueyan — A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I

pairs.source_zh: 有个福州人，名叫王有龄，
pairs.source_en: There was a man from Fuzhou named Wang Youling.
pairs.zh: 有个福州人，名叫王有龄，
pairs.en: There was a man from Fuzhou named Wang Youling.

pairs.source_zh: 他的父亲是候补道，分发浙江，在杭州一住数年，没有奉委过什么好差使。
pairs.source_en: His father, an expectant circuit intendant assigned to Zhejiang, had lived in Hangzhou for several years without receiving any worthwhile appointment.
pairs.zh: 他的父亲是候补道，分发浙江，在杭州一住数年，没有奉委过什么好差使。
pairs.en: His father, an expectant circuit intendant assigned to Zhejiang, had lived in Hangzhou for several years without receiving any worthwhile appointment.

pairs.source_zh: 老病侵寻，心情抑郁，死在异乡。
pairs.source_en: Worn down by age and illness, and burdened by disappointment, he died far from home.
pairs.zh: 老病侵寻，心情抑郁，死在异乡。
pairs.en: Worn down by age and illness, and burdened by disappointment, he died far from home.

pairs.source_zh: 身后没有留下多少钱，
pairs.source_en: He left little money.
pairs.zh: 身后没有留下多少钱，
pairs.en: He left little money.

pairs.source_zh: 运灵柩回福州，要好一笔盘缠，而且家乡也没有什么可以倚靠的亲友，
pairs.source_en: Transporting his coffin back to Fuzhou would have cost a substantial sum, and there were no relatives or friends in their home town on whom the family could rely.
pairs.zh: 运灵柩回福州，要好一笔盘缠，而且家乡也没有什么可以倚靠的亲友，
pairs.en: Transporting his coffin back to Fuzhou would have cost a substantial sum, and there were no relatives or friends in their home town on whom the family could rely.

pairs.source_zh: 王有龄就只好奉母寄居在异地了。
pairs.source_en: Wang Youling therefore had little choice but to remain in Hangzhou with his mother.
pairs.zh: 王有龄就只好奉母寄居在异地了。
pairs.en: Wang Youling therefore had little choice but to remain in Hangzhou with his mother.

pairs.source_zh: 境况不好，而且举目无亲，王有龄混得很不成样子，
pairs.source_en: Short of money and with no one to turn to, Wang lived in miserable circumstances.
pairs.zh: 境况不好，而且举目无亲，王有龄混得很不成样子，
pairs.en: Short of money and with no one to turn to, Wang lived in miserable circumstances.

pairs.source_zh: 每天在“梅花碑”一家茶店里穷泡，一壶“龙井”泡成白开水还舍不得走，
pairs.source_en: He spent his days lingering in a teahouse at Meihuabei, reluctant to leave even after his pot of Longjing tea had been brewed until it tasted like plain water.
pairs.zh: 每天在“梅花碑”一家茶店里穷泡，一壶“龙井”泡成白开水还舍不得走，
pairs.en: He spent his days lingering in a teahouse at Meihuabei, reluctant to leave even after his pot of Longjing tea had been brewed until it tasted like plain water.

pairs.source_zh: 中午四个制钱买两个烧饼，算是一顿。
pairs.source_en: At noon he spent four copper coins on two baked flatbreads and called that a meal.
pairs.zh: 中午四个制钱买两个烧饼，算是一顿。
pairs.en: At noon he spent four copper coins on two baked flatbreads and called that a meal.

pairs.source_zh: 三十岁的人，潦倒落拓，无精打采，叫人看了起反感。
pairs.source_en: At thirty, he was shabby, dispirited, and down on his luck—a sight that put people off.
pairs.zh: 三十岁的人，潦倒落拓，无精打采，叫人看了起反感。
pairs.en: At thirty, he was shabby, dispirited, and down on his luck—a sight that put people off.

pairs.source_zh: 他的架子还大，经常两眼朝天，那就越发没有人爱理他了。
pairs.source_en: Yet he still gave himself airs, often looking down his nose at everyone, which made them even less inclined to have anything to do with him.
pairs.zh: 他的架子还大，经常两眼朝天，那就越发没有人爱理他了。
pairs.en: Yet he still gave himself airs, often looking down his nose at everyone, which made them even less inclined to have anything to do with him.

pairs.source_zh: 唯一的例外是个二十岁左右的少年，王有龄只知道他叫“小胡”。
pairs.source_en: The sole exception was a young man of about twenty, whom Wang knew only as Young Hu.
pairs.zh: 唯一的例外是个二十岁左右的少年，王有龄只知道他叫“小胡”。
pairs.en: The sole exception was a young man of about twenty, whom Wang knew only as Young Hu.

pairs.source_zh: 小胡生得一双四面八方都照顾得到的眼睛，加上一张常开的笑口，而且为人“四海”，所以人缘极好。
pairs.source_en: He had eyes that seemed to take in everything around him, a ready smile, and an easy generosity that made him welcome wherever he went.
pairs.zh: 小胡生得一双四面八方都照顾得到的眼睛，加上一张常开的笑口，而且为人“四海”，所以人缘极好。
pairs.en: He had eyes that seemed to take in everything around him, a ready smile, and an easy generosity that made him welcome wherever he went.

pairs.source_zh: 不过，王有龄跟他只是点头之交，也识不透他的身分，
pairs.source_en: Wang, however, knew him only well enough to exchange a nod and could not make out his circumstances.
pairs.zh: 不过，王有龄跟他只是点头之交，也识不透他的身分，
pairs.en: Wang, however, knew him only well enough to exchange a nod and could not make out his circumstances.

pairs.source_zh: 有时很阔气，有时似乎很窘，
pairs.source_en: At times he seemed well supplied with money; at others, decidedly short of it.
pairs.zh: 有时很阔气，有时似乎很窘，
pairs.en: At times he seemed well supplied with money; at others, decidedly short of it.

pairs.source_zh: 但不管如何，总是衣衫光鲜，
pairs.source_en: Whatever his fortunes, he was always neatly dressed.
pairs.zh: 但不管如何，总是衣衫光鲜，
pairs.en: Whatever his fortunes, he was always neatly dressed.

pairs.source_zh: 象这初夏的天气，一件细白夏布长衫，浆洗得极其挺括，里面是纺绸小褂裤，
pairs.source_en: In this early-summer weather, for instance, he wore a fine white ramie gown, washed and starched until it was beautifully crisp, over a short silk jacket and silk trousers.
pairs.zh: 象这初夏的天气，一件细白夏布长衫，浆洗得极其挺括，里面是纺绸小褂裤，
pairs.en: In this early-summer weather, for instance, he wore a fine white ramie gown, washed and starched until it was beautifully crisp, over a short silk jacket and silk trousers.

pairs.source_zh: 脚上白竹布的袜子，玄色贡缎的双梁鞋，
pairs.source_en: His socks were of white cotton, and his black satin shoes had twin raised seams.
pairs.zh: 脚上白竹布的袜子，玄色贡缎的双梁鞋，
pairs.en: His socks were of white cotton, and his black satin shoes had twin raised seams.

pairs.source_zh: 跟王有龄身上那件打过补钉的青布长衫一比，小胡真可以说是“公子哥儿”了。
pairs.source_en: Beside Wang's patched blue cotton gown, Young Hu's appearance was positively that of a wealthy young gentleman.
pairs.zh: 跟王有龄身上那件打过补钉的青布长衫一比，小胡真可以说是“公子哥儿”了。
pairs.en: Beside Wang's patched blue cotton gown, Young Hu's appearance was positively that of a wealthy young gentleman.

pairs.source_zh: 他倒是有意结交王有龄，王有龄却以自惭形秽，淡淡地不肯跟他接近。
pairs.source_en: Young Hu clearly wished to make friends with Wang, but Wang felt ashamed of his own poverty and kept him at a distance.
pairs.zh: 他倒是有意结交王有龄，王有龄却以自惭形秽，淡淡地不肯跟他接近。
pairs.en: Young Hu clearly wished to make friends with Wang, but Wang felt ashamed of his own poverty and kept him at a distance.

pairs.source_zh: 这一天下午的茶客特别多，小胡跟王有龄“拼桌”，
pairs.source_en: One afternoon the teahouse was unusually crowded, and the two shared a table.
pairs.zh: 这一天下午的茶客特别多，小胡跟王有龄“拼桌”，
pairs.en: One afternoon the teahouse was unusually crowded, and the two shared a table.

pairs.source_zh: 他去下了两盘象棋，
pairs.source_en: Young Hu went off to play a couple of games of Chinese chess.
pairs.zh: 他去下了两盘象棋，
pairs.en: Young Hu went off to play a couple of games of Chinese chess.

pairs.source_zh: 笑嘻嘻走回来说：“王有龄，走，走，
pairs.source_en: When he returned, he was beaming. “Wang Youling, come along!
pairs.zh: 笑嘻嘻走回来说：“王有龄，走，走，
pairs.en: When he returned, he was beaming. “Wang Youling, come along!

pairs.source_zh: 我请你去‘摆一碗’。”
pairs.source_en: Let me buy you a drink.”
pairs.zh: 我请你去‘摆一碗’。”
pairs.en: Let me buy you a drink.”

pairs.source_zh: 摆一碗是杭州的乡谈，意思是到小酒店去对酌一番。
pairs.source_en: His expression, “set out a bowl,” was a Hangzhou phrase for going to a little tavern to share some wine.
pairs.zh: 摆一碗是杭州的乡谈，意思是到小酒店去对酌一番。
pairs.en: His expression, “set out a bowl,” was a Hangzhou phrase for going to a little tavern to share some wine.

pairs.source_zh: “谢谢。不必破费。”
pairs.source_en: “Thank you, but you needn't go to the expense.”
pairs.zh: “谢谢。不必破费。”
pairs.en: “Thank you, but you needn't go to the expense.”

pairs.source_zh: “自有人请客。
pairs.source_en: “Someone else is paying.
pairs.zh: “自有人请客。
pairs.en: “Someone else is paying.

pairs.source_zh: 你看！”
pairs.source_en: Look!”
pairs.zh: 你看！”
pairs.en: Look!”

pairs.source_zh: 他打开手巾包，里面包有二两碎银子，
pairs.source_en: He opened a bundle wrapped in a handkerchief to reveal two taels of broken silver.
pairs.zh: 他打开手巾包，里面包有二两碎银子，
pairs.en: He opened a bundle wrapped in a handkerchief to reveal two taels of broken silver.

pairs.source_zh: 得意地笑道：“第一盘‘双车错’，第二盘‘马后炮’，
pairs.source_en: Grinning proudly, he said, “In the first game I caught him with a pair of chariots; in the second, with a cannon behind a horse.
pairs.zh: 得意地笑道：“第一盘‘双车错’，第二盘‘马后炮’，
pairs.en: Grinning proudly, he said, “In the first game I caught him with a pair of chariots; in the second, with a cannon behind a horse.

pairs.source_zh: 第三盘，小卒‘逼宫’，
pairs.source_en: In the third, a little pawn cornered his general.
pairs.zh: 第三盘，小卒‘逼宫’，
pairs.en: In the third, a little pawn cornered his general.

pairs.source_zh: 杀得路断人稀。
pairs.source_en: I routed them so thoroughly that there was no one left to play.
pairs.zh: 杀得路断人稀。
pairs.en: I routed them so thoroughly that there was no one left to play.

pairs.source_zh: 不然，我还要赢。”
pairs.source_en: Otherwise, I'd have won still more.”
pairs.zh: 不然，我还要赢。”
pairs.en: Otherwise, I'd have won still more.”

pairs.source_zh: 为了盛情难却，王有龄跟着去了。
pairs.source_en: Unable to resist such a warm invitation, Wang went along.
pairs.zh: 为了盛情难却，王有龄跟着去了。
pairs.en: Unable to resist such a warm invitation, Wang went along.

pairs.source_zh: 一路走到“城隍山”——“立马吴山第一峰”的吴山，挑了个可以眺望万家灯火的空旷地方，
pairs.source_en: They walked to City God Hill—the Wushan celebrated in the line, “Rein in your horse upon Wushan's foremost peak”—and chose an open spot overlooking the lights of countless homes.
pairs.zh: 一路走到“城隍山”——“立马吴山第一峰”的吴山，挑了个可以眺望万家灯火的空旷地方，
pairs.en: They walked to City God Hill—the Wushan celebrated in the line, “Rein in your horse upon Wushan's foremost peak”—and chose an open spot overlooking the lights of countless homes.

pairs.source_zh: 一面喝酒一面闲谈。
pairs.source_en: There they drank and talked.
pairs.zh: 一面喝酒一面闲谈。
pairs.en: There they drank and talked.

pairs.source_zh: 酒到半酣，闲话也说得差不多了，小胡忽然提高了声音说：“王有龄，我有句话，老早想问你了。
pairs.source_en: When the wine had begun to take effect and their small talk was nearly exhausted, Young Hu suddenly raised his voice. “Wang Youling, there's something I've been wanting to ask you for a long time.
pairs.zh: 酒到半酣，闲话也说得差不多了，小胡忽然提高了声音说：“王有龄，我有句话，老早想问你了。
pairs.en: When the wine had begun to take effect and their small talk was nearly exhausted, Young Hu suddenly raised his voice. “Wang Youling, there's something I've been wanting to ask you for a long time.

pairs.source_zh: 我看你不是没本事的人，
pairs.source_en: You don't strike me as a man without ability.
pairs.zh: 我看你不是没本事的人，
pairs.en: You don't strike me as a man without ability.

pairs.source_zh: 而且我也懂点‘麻衣相法’，看你是大贵之相，
pairs.source_en: I also know a little of the Mayi art of face-reading, and yours looks like the face of a man destined for high office.
pairs.zh: 而且我也懂点‘麻衣相法’，看你是大贵之相，
pairs.en: I also know a little of the Mayi art of face-reading, and yours looks like the face of a man destined for high office.

pairs.source_zh: 何以一天到晚‘孵’茶店？”
pairs.source_en: Why do you spend all day nesting in a teahouse?”
pairs.zh: 何以一天到晚‘孵’茶店？”
pairs.en: Why do you spend all day nesting in a teahouse?”

pairs.source_zh: 王有龄摇摇头，
pairs.source_en: Wang shook his head.
pairs.zh: 王有龄摇摇头，
pairs.en: Wang shook his head.

pairs.source_zh: 拈了块城隍山上有名的油饼，慢慢咬着，双眼望着远处，是那种说不出来的茫然落寞。
pairs.source_en: He picked up one of the fried cakes for which City God Hill was famous and ate it slowly, gazing into the distance with an expression of bewildered loneliness that was hard to put into words.
pairs.zh: 拈了块城隍山上有名的油饼，慢慢咬着，双眼望着远处，是那种说不出来的茫然落寞。
pairs.en: He picked up one of the fried cakes for which City God Hill was famous and ate it slowly, gazing into the distance with an expression of bewildered loneliness that was hard to put into words.

pairs.source_zh: “叫我说什么？”
pairs.source_en: “What am I supposed to say?”
pairs.zh: “叫我说什么？”
pairs.en: “What am I supposed to say?”

pairs.source_zh: 王有龄转过脸来盯着小胡，仿佛要跟他吵架似的，
pairs.source_en: He turned and stared at Young Hu as though about to quarrel with him.
pairs.zh: 王有龄转过脸来盯着小胡，仿佛要跟他吵架似的，
pairs.en: He turned and stared at Young Hu as though about to quarrel with him.

pairs.source_zh: “做生意要本钱，做官也要本钱，
pairs.source_en: “It takes capital to go into business, and it takes capital to become an official.
pairs.zh: “做生意要本钱，做官也要本钱，
pairs.en: “It takes capital to go into business, and it takes capital to become an official.

pairs.source_zh: 没本钱说什么？”
pairs.source_en: Without capital, what's there to talk about?”
pairs.zh: 没本钱说什么？”
pairs.en: Without capital, what's there to talk about?”

pairs.source_zh: “做官？”
pairs.source_en: “Become an official?”
pairs.zh: “做官？”
pairs.en: “Become an official?”

pairs.source_zh: 小胡大为诧异，
pairs.source_en: Young Hu was astonished.
pairs.zh: 小胡大为诧异，
pairs.en: Young Hu was astonished.

pairs.source_zh: “怎么做法？
pairs.source_en: “How would you manage that?
pairs.zh: “怎么做法？
pairs.en: “How would you manage that?

pairs.source_zh: 你同我一样，连‘学’都没有‘进’过，
pairs.source_en: You're like me: you've never even earned the first examination qualification.
pairs.zh: 你同我一样，连‘学’都没有‘进’过，
pairs.en: You're like me: you've never even earned the first examination qualification.

pairs.source_zh: 是个白丁。
pairs.source_en: We're ordinary men without degrees.
pairs.zh: 是个白丁。
pairs.en: We're ordinary men without degrees.

pairs.source_zh: 哪里来的官做？”
pairs.source_en: Where would an official post come from?”
pairs.zh: 哪里来的官做？”
pairs.en: Where would an official post come from?”

pairs.source_zh: “不可以‘捐班’吗？”
pairs.source_en: “Couldn't I enter by purchasing a qualification?”
pairs.zh: “不可以‘捐班’吗？”
pairs.en: “Couldn't I enter by purchasing a qualification?”

pairs.source_zh: 小胡默然。心里有些看不起王有龄。
pairs.source_en: Young Hu said nothing, but inwardly he thought rather less of Wang.
pairs.zh: 小胡默然。心里有些看不起王有龄。
pairs.en: Young Hu said nothing, but inwardly he thought rather less of Wang.

pairs.source_zh: 捐官的情形不外乎两种，
pairs.source_en: There were generally two kinds of people who bought official status.
pairs.zh: 捐官的情形不外乎两种，
pairs.en: There were generally two kinds of people who bought official status.

pairs.source_zh: 一种是做生意发了财，富而不贵，美中不足，
pairs.source_en: One was the merchant who had made his fortune but felt that wealth without rank left something to be desired.
pairs.zh: 一种是做生意发了财，富而不贵，美中不足，
pairs.en: One was the merchant who had made his fortune but felt that wealth without rank left something to be desired.

pairs.source_zh: 捐个功名好提高身价，
pairs.source_en: He bought a title to raise his standing.
pairs.zh: 捐个功名好提高身价，
pairs.en: He bought a title to raise his standing.

pairs.source_zh: 象扬州的盐商，个个都是花几千两银子捐来的道台，
pairs.source_en: The salt merchants of Yangzhou, for example, had each spent several thousand taels to acquire the rank of circuit intendant.
pairs.zh: 象扬州的盐商，个个都是花几千两银子捐来的道台，
pairs.en: The salt merchants of Yangzhou, for example, had each spent several thousand taels to acquire the rank of circuit intendant.

pairs.source_zh: 那一来便可以与地方官称兄道弟，平起平坐，
pairs.source_en: That enabled them to address local officials as brothers and meet them as equals.
pairs.zh: 那一来便可以与地方官称兄道弟，平起平坐，
pairs.en: That enabled them to address local officials as brothers and meet them as equals.

pairs.source_zh: 否则就不算“缙绅先生”，育事上得公堂，要跪着回话。
pairs.source_en: Without such standing, they did not count as members of the gentry and had to kneel when answering questions in court.
pairs.zh: 否则就不算“缙绅先生”，育事上得公堂，要跪着回话。
pairs.en: Without such standing, they did not count as members of the gentry and had to kneel when answering questions in court.

pairs.source_zh: 再有一种，本是官员家的子弟，书也读得不错，就是运气不好，三年大比，次次名落孙山，
pairs.source_en: The other kind was the son of an official: well educated, perhaps, but unlucky enough to fail the examinations every three years.
pairs.zh: 再有一种，本是官员家的子弟，书也读得不错，就是运气不好，三年大比，次次名落孙山，
pairs.en: The other kind was the son of an official: well educated, perhaps, but unlucky enough to fail the examinations every three years.

pairs.source_zh: 年纪大了，家计也艰窘了，总得想个谋生之道，
pairs.source_en: As he grew older and his family resources dwindled, he had to find a way to earn a living.
pairs.zh: 年纪大了，家计也艰窘了，总得想个谋生之道，
pairs.en: As he grew older and his family resources dwindled, he had to find a way to earn a living.

pairs.source_zh: 走的就是“做官”的这条路，改行也无从改起，
pairs.source_en: Official service was the only career for which he had been prepared; he could scarcely begin again in another trade.
pairs.zh: 走的就是“做官”的这条路，改行也无从改起，
pairs.en: Official service was the only career for which he had been prepared; he could scarcely begin again in another trade.

pairs.source_zh: 只好卖田卖地，拜托亲友，凑一笔去捐个官做。
pairs.source_en: So he sold fields and property, sought help from relatives and friends, and scraped together enough money to buy a qualification.
pairs.zh: 只好卖田卖地，拜托亲友，凑一笔去捐个官做。
pairs.en: So he sold fields and property, sought help from relatives and friends, and scraped together enough money to buy a qualification.

pairs.source_zh: 象王有龄这样，年纪还轻，
pairs.source_en: Wang Youling, however, was still young.
pairs.zh: 象王有龄这样，年纪还轻，
pairs.en: Wang Youling, however, was still young.

pairs.source_zh: 应该刻苦用功，从正途上去巴结，
pairs.source_en: Surely he ought to study hard and work his way up through the regular examinations.
pairs.zh: 应该刻苦用功，从正途上去巴结，
pairs.en: Surely he ought to study hard and work his way up through the regular examinations.

pairs.source_zh: 不此之图，而况又穷得衣食不周，却痴心妄想去捐班，
pairs.source_en: Instead, though he could barely feed and clothe himself, he was dreaming of buying his way into office.
pairs.zh: 不此之图，而况又穷得衣食不周，却痴心妄想去捐班，
pairs.en: Instead, though he could barely feed and clothe himself, he was dreaming of buying his way into office.

pairs.source_zh: 岂不是没出息？
pairs.source_en: Did that not show a lack of ambition?
pairs.zh: 岂不是没出息？
pairs.en: Did that not show a lack of ambition?

pairs.source_zh: 王有龄看出他心里的意思，
pairs.source_en: Wang guessed what he was thinking.
pairs.zh: 王有龄看出他心里的意思，
pairs.en: Wang guessed what he was thinking.

pairs.source_zh: 有几杯酒在肚里，便不似平时那么沉着了，
pairs.source_en: With several cups of wine inside him, he was less restrained than usual.
pairs.zh: 有几杯酒在肚里，便不似平时那么沉着了，
pairs.en: With several cups of wine inside him, he was less restrained than usual.

pairs.source_zh: “小胡！”他说，“我告诉你一句话，信不信由你，
pairs.source_en: “Young Hu,” he said, “I'll tell you something, whether you believe it or not.
pairs.zh: “小胡！”他说，“我告诉你一句话，信不信由你，
pairs.en: “Young Hu,” he said, “I'll tell you something, whether you believe it or not.

pairs.source_zh: 先父在日，替我捐过一个‘盐大使’。”
pairs.source_en: While my father was alive, he bought me a qualification as a salt-station superintendent.”
pairs.zh: 先父在日，替我捐过一个‘盐大使’。”
pairs.en: While my father was alive, he bought me a qualification as a salt-station superintendent.”

pairs.source_zh: 小胡最机警，
pairs.source_en: Young Hu was exceptionally quick-witted.
pairs.zh: 小胡最机警，
pairs.en: Young Hu was exceptionally quick-witted.

pairs.source_zh: 一看他的神情，就知道决非假话，
pairs.source_en: One look at Wang's expression told him this was no invention.
pairs.zh: 一看他的神情，就知道决非假话，
pairs.en: One look at Wang's expression told him this was no invention.

pairs.source_zh: 随即笑道：“唷！失敬，失敬，
pairs.source_en: He immediately smiled. “Oh! My apologies!
pairs.zh: 随即笑道：“唷！失敬，失敬，
pairs.en: He immediately smiled. “Oh! My apologies!

pairs.source_zh: 原来是王老爷，
pairs.source_en: So you are His Honour Wang.
pairs.zh: 原来是王老爷，
pairs.en: So you are His Honour Wang.

pairs.source_zh: 一直连名带姓叫你，
pairs.source_en: And all this time I've been calling you by your full name.
pairs.zh: 一直连名带姓叫你，
pairs.en: And all this time I've been calling you by your full name.

pairs.source_zh: 不知者不罪。”
pairs.source_en: You must forgive an ignorant man.”
pairs.zh: 不知者不罪。”
pairs.en: You must forgive an ignorant man.”

pairs.source_zh: “不要挖苦我了！”王有龄苦笑道，
pairs.source_en: “Don't make fun of me.” Wang smiled bitterly.
pairs.zh: “不要挖苦我了！”王有龄苦笑道，
pairs.en: “Don't make fun of me.” Wang smiled bitterly.

pairs.source_zh: “说句实话，除非是你，别人面前我再也不说，
pairs.source_en: “To tell the truth, you're the only person I'd say this to.
pairs.zh: “说句实话，除非是你，别人面前我再也不说，
pairs.en: “To tell the truth, you're the only person I'd say this to.

pairs.source_zh: 说了反惹人耻笑。”
pairs.source_en: Anyone else would only laugh.”
pairs.zh: 说了反惹人耻笑。”
pairs.en: Anyone else would only laugh.”

pairs.source_zh: “我不是笑你。”
pairs.source_en: “I'm not laughing at you.”
pairs.zh: “我不是笑你。”
pairs.en: “I'm not laughing at you.”

pairs.source_zh: 小胡放出庄重的神态问道，“不过，有一层我不明白，
pairs.source_en: Young Hu grew serious. “But there's one thing I don't understand.
pairs.zh: 小胡放出庄重的神态问道，“不过，有一层我不明白，
pairs.en: Young Hu grew serious. “But there's one thing I don't understand.

pairs.source_zh: 既然你是盐大使，我们浙江沿海有好几十个盐场，为什么不给你补缺？”
pairs.source_en: If you're qualified to be a salt-station superintendent, why haven't you been appointed? There must be dozens of saltworks along the Zhejiang coast.”
pairs.zh: 既然你是盐大使，我们浙江沿海有好几十个盐场，为什么不给你补缺？”
pairs.en: If you're qualified to be a salt-station superintendent, why haven't you been appointed? There must be dozens of saltworks along the Zhejiang coast.”

pairs.source_zh: “你只知其一，不知其二……”
pairs.source_en: “You know only half the story...”
pairs.zh: “你只知其一，不知其二……”
pairs.en: “You know only half the story...”

pairs.source_zh: 捐官只是捐一个虚衔，
pairs.source_en: Purchasing office meant, in the first instance, purchasing an empty title.
pairs.zh: 捐官只是捐一个虚衔，
pairs.en: Purchasing office meant, in the first instance, purchasing an empty title.

pairs.source_zh: 凭一张吏部所发的“执照”，取得某一类官员的资格，
pairs.source_en: A certificate issued by the Board of Civil Appointments made its holder eligible for a particular category of post.
pairs.zh: 凭一张吏部所发的“执照”，取得某一类官员的资格，
pairs.en: A certificate issued by the Board of Civil Appointments made its holder eligible for a particular category of post.

pairs.source_zh: 如果要想补缺，必得到吏部报到，称为“投供”，然后抽签分发到某一省候补。
pairs.source_en: To obtain an actual appointment, he first had to report to the Board for registration and then draw lots for assignment to a province, where he would wait for a vacancy.
pairs.zh: 如果要想补缺，必得到吏部报到，称为“投供”，然后抽签分发到某一省候补。
pairs.en: To obtain an actual appointment, he first had to report to the Board for registration and then draw lots for assignment to a province, where he would wait for a vacancy.

pairs.source_zh: 王有龄尚未“投供”，
pairs.source_en: Wang had not even completed the registration.
pairs.zh: 王有龄尚未“投供”，
pairs.en: Wang had not even completed the registration.

pairs.source_zh: 哪里谈得到补缺？
pairs.source_en: How could he expect a substantive post?
pairs.zh: 哪里谈得到补缺？
pairs.en: How could he expect a substantive post?

pairs.source_zh: 讲完这些捐官补缺的程序，王有龄又说：“我所说的要‘本钱’，就是进京投供的盘缠。
pairs.source_en: After explaining the procedure, Wang added, “The ‘capital’ I mean is the money to travel to the capital and register.
pairs.zh: 讲完这些捐官补缺的程序，王有龄又说：“我所说的要‘本钱’，就是进京投供的盘缠。
pairs.en: After explaining the procedure, Wang added, “The ‘capital’ I mean is the money to travel to the capital and register.

pairs.source_zh: 如果境况再宽裕些，我还想‘改捐’。”
pairs.source_en: If I had a little more to spare, I'd also like to purchase a different qualification.”
pairs.zh: 如果境况再宽裕些，我还想‘改捐’。”
pairs.en: If I had a little more to spare, I'd also like to purchase a different qualification.”

pairs.source_zh: “改捐个什么‘班子’？”
pairs.source_en: “For what sort of post?”
pairs.zh: “改捐个什么‘班子’？”
pairs.en: “For what sort of post?”

pairs.source_zh: “改捐个知县。
pairs.source_en: “A county magistracy.
pairs.zh: “改捐个知县。
pairs.en: “A county magistracy.

pairs.source_zh: 盐大使正八品，知县正七品，
pairs.source_en: A salt-station superintendent holds the principal eighth rank; a county magistrate holds the principal seventh.
pairs.zh: 盐大使正八品，知县正七品，
pairs.en: A salt-station superintendent holds the principal eighth rank; a county magistrate holds the principal seventh.

pairs.source_zh: 改捐花不了多少钱。出路可就大不相同了。”
pairs.source_en: Changing qualifications wouldn't cost very much, but the prospects would be entirely different.”
pairs.zh: 改捐花不了多少钱。出路可就大不相同了。”
pairs.en: Changing qualifications wouldn't cost very much, but the prospects would be entirely different.”

pairs.source_zh: “怎么呢？”
pairs.source_en: “How so?”
pairs.zh: “怎么呢？”
pairs.en: “How so?”

pairs.source_zh: “盐大使只管盐场，
pairs.source_en: “A salt-station superintendent manages a saltworks, nothing more.
pairs.zh: “盐大使只管盐场，
pairs.en: “A salt-station superintendent manages a saltworks, nothing more.

pairs.source_zh: 出息倒也不错，不过没有意思。
pairs.source_en: The income can be quite good, but the work has little meaning.
pairs.zh: 出息倒也不错，不过没有意思。
pairs.en: The income can be quite good, but the work has little meaning.

pairs.source_zh: 知县虽小，一县的父母官，
pairs.source_en: A county magistrate may be a minor official, yet he is responsible for the welfare of an entire county.
pairs.zh: 知县虽小，一县的父母官，
pairs.en: A county magistrate may be a minor official, yet he is responsible for the welfare of an entire county.

pairs.source_zh: 能杀人也能活人，
pairs.source_en: He has the power to take lives or save them.
pairs.zh: 能杀人也能活人，
pairs.en: He has the power to take lives or save them.

pairs.source_zh: 可以好好做一番事业。”
pairs.source_en: He can accomplish something worthwhile.”
pairs.zh: 可以好好做一番事业。”
pairs.en: He can accomplish something worthwhile.”

pairs.source_zh: 这两句话使得小胡肃然起敬，把刚才看不起他的那点感想，一扫而空了。
pairs.source_en: These words filled Young Hu with respect, sweeping away every trace of his earlier contempt.
pairs.zh: 这两句话使得小胡肃然起敬，把刚才看不起他的那点感想，一扫而空了。
pairs.en: These words filled Young Hu with respect, sweeping away every trace of his earlier contempt.

pairs.source_zh: “再说，知县到底是正印官，
pairs.source_en: “Besides, a county magistrate is the chief official of his jurisdiction.
pairs.zh: “再说，知县到底是正印官，
pairs.en: “Besides, a county magistrate is the chief official of his jurisdiction.

pairs.source_zh: 不比盐大使，说起来总是佐杂，又是捐班的佐杂，
pairs.source_en: A salt-station superintendent is only a subordinate, and one who has purchased his qualification at that.
pairs.zh: 不比盐大使，说起来总是佐杂，又是捐班的佐杂，
pairs.en: A salt-station superintendent is only a subordinate, and one who has purchased his qualification at that.

pairs.source_zh: 到处做‘磕头虫’，
pairs.source_en: He has to bow and scrape wherever he goes.
pairs.zh: 到处做‘磕头虫’，
pairs.en: He has to bow and scrape wherever he goes.

pairs.source_zh: 与我的性情也不相宜。”
pairs.source_en: That doesn't suit my temperament.”
pairs.zh: 与我的性情也不相宜。”
pairs.en: That doesn't suit my temperament.”

pairs.source_zh: “对，对！”小胡不断点头，
pairs.source_en: “Quite right!” Young Hu nodded repeatedly.
pairs.zh: “对，对！”小胡不断点头，
pairs.en: “Quite right!” Young Hu nodded repeatedly.

pairs.source_zh: “那么，这一来，你要多少‘本钱’才够呢？”
pairs.source_en: “Then how much ‘capital’ would you need?”
pairs.zh: “那么，这一来，你要多少‘本钱’才够呢？”
pairs.en: “Then how much ‘capital’ would you need?”

pairs.source_zh: “总得五百两银子。”
pairs.source_en: “At least five hundred taels of silver.”
pairs.zh: “总得五百两银子。”
pairs.en: “At least five hundred taels of silver.”

pairs.source_en: “Oh.”
pairs.en: “Oh.”

pairs.source_zh: 小胡没有再接口，王有龄也不再提，
pairs.source_en: Young Hu said no more, and Wang let the subject drop.
pairs.zh: 小胡没有再接口，王有龄也不再提，
pairs.en: Young Hu said no more, and Wang let the subject drop.

pairs.source_zh: 五百两银子不是小数目，
pairs.source_en: Five hundred taels was no small sum.
pairs.zh: 五百两银子不是小数目，
pairs.en: Five hundred taels was no small sum.

pairs.source_zh: 小胡不见得会有，就有也不见得肯借。
pairs.source_en: Young Hu might not possess it; even if he did, he might not be willing to lend it.
pairs.zh: 小胡不见得会有，就有也不见得肯借。
pairs.en: Young Hu might not possess it; even if he did, he might not be willing to lend it.

pairs.source_zh: 两人各有心事，
pairs.source_en: Each was now absorbed in his own thoughts.
pairs.zh: 两人各有心事，
pairs.en: Each was now absorbed in his own thoughts.

pairs.source_zh: 吃闷酒无味，天也黑上来了，
pairs.source_en: Drinking in silence had lost its charm, and darkness was gathering.
pairs.zh: 吃闷酒无味，天也黑上来了，
pairs.en: Drinking in silence had lost its charm, and darkness was gathering.

pairs.source_zh: 王有龄推杯告辞，
pairs.source_en: Wang pushed his cup away and rose to leave.
pairs.zh: 王有龄推杯告辞，
pairs.en: Wang pushed his cup away and rose to leave.

pairs.source_zh: 小胡也不留他，
pairs.source_en: Young Hu did not try to detain him.
pairs.zh: 小胡也不留他，
pairs.en: Young Hu did not try to detain him.

pairs.source_zh: 只说：“明天下午，我仍旧在这里等你，
pairs.source_en: He merely said, “I'll be here again tomorrow afternoon.
pairs.zh: 只说：“明天下午，我仍旧在这里等你，
pairs.en: He merely said, “I'll be here again tomorrow afternoon.

pairs.source_zh: 你来！”
pairs.source_en: Come and meet me.”
pairs.zh: 你来！”
pairs.en: Come and meet me.”

pairs.source_zh: “有事吗？”王有龄微感诧异，
pairs.source_en: “Is there something you want?” Wang asked, slightly surprised.
pairs.zh: “有事吗？”王有龄微感诧异，
pairs.en: “Is there something you want?” Wang asked, slightly surprised.

pairs.source_zh: “何不此刻就说？”
pairs.source_en: “Why not tell me now?”
pairs.zh: “何不此刻就说？”
pairs.en: “Why not tell me now?”

pairs.source_zh: “我有点小事托你，此刻还没有想停当。
pairs.source_en: “There's a small favour I'd like to ask, but I haven't quite thought it through.
pairs.zh: “我有点小事托你，此刻还没有想停当。
pairs.en: “There's a small favour I'd like to ask, but I haven't quite thought it through.

pairs.source_zh: 还是明天下午再谈。
pairs.source_en: Let's talk tomorrow afternoon.
pairs.zh: 还是明天下午再谈。
pairs.en: Let's talk tomorrow afternoon.

pairs.source_zh: 你一定要来，
pairs.source_en: You must come.
pairs.zh: 你一定要来，
pairs.en: You must come.

pairs.source_zh: 我在这里坐等，不见不散。”
pairs.source_en: I'll wait here until you do.”
pairs.zh: 我在这里坐等，不见不散。”
pairs.en: I'll wait here until you do.”

pairs.source_zh: 看他如此叮嘱，王有龄也就答应了。
pairs.source_en: Young Hu was so insistent that Wang agreed.
pairs.zh: 看他如此叮嘱，王有龄也就答应了。
pairs.en: Young Hu was so insistent that Wang agreed.

pairs.source_zh: 到了第二天下午，依约而至，不见小胡的踪影。
pairs.source_en: The next afternoon he arrived as promised, but there was no sign of his young acquaintance.
pairs.zh: 到了第二天下午，依约而至，不见小胡的踪影。
pairs.en: The next afternoon he arrived as promised, but there was no sign of his young acquaintance.

pairs.source_zh: 泡一碗茶得好几文钱，对王有龄来说，是一种浪费，于是沿着山路一直走了过去。
pairs.source_en: A bowl of tea cost several copper coins, which Wang considered an unnecessary extravagance, so he continued along the hillside path.
pairs.zh: 泡一碗茶得好几文钱，对王有龄来说，是一种浪费，于是沿着山路一直走了过去。
pairs.en: A bowl of tea cost several copper coins, which Wang considered an unnecessary extravagance, so he continued along the hillside path.

pairs.source_zh: 城隍山上有好几座庙，
pairs.source_en: There were several temples on City God Hill.
pairs.zh: 城隍山上有好几座庙，
pairs.en: There were several temples on City God Hill.

pairs.source_zh: 庙前有耍把戏的，打拳卖膏药的，摆象棋摊的，
pairs.source_en: Before their gates stood acrobats, performers demonstrating martial arts to sell their medicinal plasters, and men with chessboards set up for challengers.
pairs.zh: 庙前有耍把戏的，打拳卖膏药的，摆象棋摊的，
pairs.en: Before their gates stood acrobats, performers demonstrating martial arts to sell their medicinal plasters, and men with chessboards set up for challengers.

pairs.source_zh: 不花钱而可以消磨时光的地方多得很。
pairs.source_en: There were plenty of ways to pass the time without spending money.
pairs.zh: 不花钱而可以消磨时光的地方多得很。
pairs.en: There were plenty of ways to pass the time without spending money.

pairs.source_zh: 他这里立一会，那面看一看，到红日衔山，方始走回原处，
pairs.source_en: Wang stopped here and watched there, returning to the meeting place only when the red sun touched the hills.
pairs.zh: 他这里立一会，那面看一看，到红日衔山，方始走回原处，
pairs.en: Wang stopped here and watched there, returning to the meeting place only when the red sun touched the hills.

pairs.source_zh: 依旧不见小胡。
pairs.source_en: Young Hu was still nowhere to be seen.
pairs.zh: 依旧不见小胡。
pairs.en: Young Hu was still nowhere to be seen.

pairs.source_zh: 是“不见不散”的死约会。
pairs.source_en: They had expressly agreed to wait until they met.
pairs.zh: 是“不见不散”的死约会。
pairs.en: They had expressly agreed to wait until they met.

pairs.source_zh: 王有龄顿感进退两难，
pairs.source_en: Wang found himself in a quandary.
pairs.zh: 王有龄顿感进退两难，
pairs.en: Wang found himself in a quandary.

pairs.source_zh: 不等是自己失约，要等，天色已暮，晚饭尚无着落。
pairs.source_en: If he left, he would be breaking his word; if he stayed, night would soon fall, and he had made no provision for supper.
pairs.zh: 不等是自己失约，要等，天色已暮，晚饭尚无着落。
pairs.en: If he left, he would be breaking his word; if he stayed, night would soon fall, and he had made no provision for supper.

pairs.source_zh: 呆了半天，越想越急，
pairs.source_en: He stood there for some time, growing more anxious with every thought.
pairs.zh: 呆了半天，越想越急，
pairs.en: He stood there for some time, growing more anxious with every thought.

pairs.source_zh: 顿一顿足，往山下便走，
pairs.source_en: Finally, he stamped his foot and started downhill.
pairs.zh: 顿一顿足，往山下便走，
pairs.en: Finally, he stamped his foot and started downhill.

pairs.source_zh: 心中自语：明天见着小胡，非说他几句不可！
pairs.source_en: Tomorrow, he told himself, he would certainly give Young Hu a piece of his mind.
pairs.zh: 心中自语：明天见着小胡，非说他几句不可！
pairs.en: Tomorrow, he told himself, he would certainly give Young Hu a piece of his mind.

pairs.source_zh: 他又不是不知道自己的境况，在外面吃碗茶都得先算一算，
pairs.source_en: The young fellow knew perfectly well how things stood with him: even a bowl of tea away from home had to be carefully considered.
pairs.zh: 他又不是不知道自己的境况，在外面吃碗茶都得先算一算，
pairs.en: The young fellow knew perfectly well how things stood with him: even a bowl of tea away from home had to be carefully considered.

pairs.source_zh: 何苦捉弄人？
pairs.source_en: Why torment him like this?
pairs.zh: 何苦捉弄人？
pairs.en: Why torment him like this?

pairs.source_zh: 走了不多几步，听见后面有人在叫：“王有龄，王有龄！”
pairs.source_en: He had gone only a few steps when someone called from behind, “Wang Youling! Wang Youling!”
pairs.zh: 走了不多几步，听见后面有人在叫：“王有龄，王有龄！”
pairs.en: He had gone only a few steps when someone called from behind, “Wang Youling! Wang Youling!”

pairs.source_zh: 转身一看，正是小胡，手里拿着手巾包，跑得气喘吁吁，满脸是汗。
pairs.source_en: He turned to see Young Hu running towards him, a handkerchief bundle in his hand, breathless and drenched in sweat.
pairs.zh: 转身一看，正是小胡，手里拿着手巾包，跑得气喘吁吁，满脸是汗。
pairs.en: He turned to see Young Hu running towards him, a handkerchief bundle in his hand, breathless and drenched in sweat.

pairs.source_zh: 见着了他的面，王有龄的气消了一半，
pairs.source_en: Half of Wang's anger vanished at the sight.
pairs.zh: 见着了他的面，王有龄的气消了一半，
pairs.en: Half of Wang's anger vanished at the sight.

pairs.source_zh: 问道：“你怎么这时候才来？”
pairs.source_en: “Why are you only arriving now?” he asked.
pairs.zh: 问道：“你怎么这时候才来？”
pairs.en: “Why are you only arriving now?” he asked.

pairs.source_zh: “我知道你等得久了，
pairs.source_en: “I know you've been waiting a long time.
pairs.zh: “我知道你等得久了，
pairs.en: “I know you've been waiting a long time.

pairs.source_zh: 对不起，对不起！”
pairs.source_en: I'm sorry, truly sorry.”
pairs.zh: 对不起，对不起！”
pairs.en: I'm sorry, truly sorry.”

pairs.source_zh: 小胡欣慰地笑着，
pairs.source_en: Young Hu smiled with relief.
pairs.zh: 小胡欣慰地笑着，
pairs.en: Young Hu smiled with relief.

pairs.source_zh: “总算还好，
pairs.source_en: “Still, all's well.
pairs.zh: “总算还好，
pairs.en: “Still, all's well.

pairs.source_zh: 耽迟不耽错。
pairs.source_en: I'm late, but I haven't missed you.
pairs.zh: 耽迟不耽错。
pairs.en: I'm late, but I haven't missed you.

pairs.source_zh: 来，来，坐下来再说。”
pairs.source_en: Come, let's sit down and talk.”
pairs.zh: 来，来，坐下来再说。”
pairs.en: Come, let's sit down and talk.”

pairs.source_zh: 王有龄也不知道他这话是什么意思？
pairs.source_en: Wang had no idea what he meant.
pairs.zh: 王有龄也不知道他这话是什么意思？
pairs.en: Wang had no idea what he meant.

pairs.source_zh: 默默地跟着他走向一副设在橱下的座头，泡了两碗茶。
pairs.source_en: He followed silently to a table beneath the eaves, where they ordered two bowls of tea.
pairs.zh: 默默地跟着他走向一副设在橱下的座头，泡了两碗茶。
pairs.en: He followed silently to a table beneath the eaves, where they ordered two bowls of tea.

pairs.source_zh: 小胡有些魂不守舍似的，
pairs.source_en: Young Hu seemed distracted.
pairs.zh: 小胡有些魂不守舍似的，
pairs.en: Young Hu seemed distracted.

pairs.source_zh: 目送着经过的行人，手里紧捏住那个手巾包。
pairs.source_en: He watched the passers-by while gripping the handkerchief bundle tightly.
pairs.zh: 目送着经过的行人，手里紧捏住那个手巾包。
pairs.en: He watched the passers-by while gripping the handkerchief bundle tightly.

pairs.source_zh: “小胡！”王有龄忍不住问了：“你说有事托我，快说吧！”
pairs.source_en: “Young Hu!” Wang could contain himself no longer. “You said you wanted a favour. What is it?”
pairs.zh: “小胡！”王有龄忍不住问了：“你说有事托我，快说吧！”
pairs.en: “Young Hu!” Wang could contain himself no longer. “You said you wanted a favour. What is it?”

pairs.source_zh: “你打开来看，
pairs.source_en: “Open this and look.
pairs.zh: “你打开来看，
pairs.en: “Open this and look.

pairs.source_zh: 不要给人看见。”他低声地说，把手巾包递了给王有龄。
pairs.source_en: Don't let anyone see,” he whispered, handing over the bundle.
pairs.zh: 不要给人看见。”他低声地说，把手巾包递了给王有龄。
pairs.en: Don't let anyone see,” he whispered, handing over the bundle.

pairs.source_zh: 他避开行人，悄悄启视，
pairs.source_en: Shielding it from passing eyes, Wang opened it discreetly.
pairs.zh: 他避开行人，悄悄启视，
pairs.en: Shielding it from passing eyes, Wang opened it discreetly.

pairs.source_zh: 里面是一叠银票，还有些碎银子，约莫有十几两。
pairs.source_en: Inside was a stack of bank drafts and some broken silver, perhaps a little over ten taels.
pairs.zh: 里面是一叠银票，还有些碎银子，约莫有十几两。
pairs.en: Inside was a stack of bank drafts and some broken silver, perhaps a little over ten taels.

pairs.source_zh: “怎么回事？”
pairs.source_en: “What's all this?”
pairs.zh: “怎么回事？”
pairs.en: “What's all this?”

pairs.source_zh: “这就是你做官的本钱。”
pairs.source_en: “The capital you need to become an official.”
pairs.zh: “这就是你做官的本钱。”
pairs.en: “The capital you need to become an official.”

pairs.source_zh: 王有龄愣住了，
pairs.source_en: Wang was stunned.
pairs.zh: 王有龄愣住了，
pairs.en: Wang was stunned.

pairs.source_zh: 一下子心里发酸，眼眶发热，
pairs.source_en: His heart suddenly ached and his eyes grew hot.
pairs.zh: 一下子心里发酸，眼眶发热，
pairs.en: His heart suddenly ached and his eyes grew hot.

pairs.source_zh: 尽力忍住眼泪，把手巾包放在桌上，却不知怎么说才好。
pairs.source_en: Fighting back tears, he put the bundle on the table, unable to find a word to say.
pairs.zh: 尽力忍住眼泪，把手巾包放在桌上，却不知怎么说才好。
pairs.en: Fighting back tears, he put the bundle on the table, unable to find a word to say.

pairs.source_zh: “你最好点一点数。
pairs.source_en: “You'd better count it.
pairs.zh: “你最好点一点数。
pairs.en: “You'd better count it.

pairs.source_zh: 其中有一张三百两的，是京城里‘大德恒’的票子，
pairs.source_en: One draft is for three hundred taels, issued by Dadeheng in the capital.
pairs.zh: 其中有一张三百两的，是京城里‘大德恒’的票子，
pairs.en: One draft is for three hundred taels, issued by Dadeheng in the capital.

pairs.source_zh: 认票不认人，你要当心失落。
pairs.source_en: It's payable to whoever presents it, so be careful not to lose it.
pairs.zh: 认票不认人，你要当心失落。
pairs.en: It's payable to whoever presents it, so be careful not to lose it.

pairs.source_zh: 另外我又替你换了些零碎票子，都是有名的‘字号’，
pairs.source_en: I've also changed some of the money into smaller drafts, all from well-known firms.
pairs.zh: 另外我又替你换了些零碎票子，都是有名的‘字号’，
pairs.en: I've also changed some of the money into smaller drafts, all from well-known firms.

pairs.source_zh: 一路上通行无阻。”
pairs.source_en: You'll be able to use them all along the way.”
pairs.zh: 一路上通行无阻。”
pairs.en: You'll be able to use them all along the way.”

pairs.source_zh: 小胡又说：“如果不为换票子，我早就来了。”
pairs.source_en: Young Hu added, “If it hadn't taken so long to change the drafts, I'd have been here much earlier.”
pairs.zh: 小胡又说：“如果不为换票子，我早就来了。”
pairs.en: Young Hu added, “If it hadn't taken so long to change the drafts, I'd have been here much earlier.”

pairs.source_zh: 这里王有龄才想出来一句话：“小胡，你为什么待我这么好？”
pairs.source_en: Only then did Wang find something to say. “Young Hu, why are you so good to me?”
pairs.zh: 这里王有龄才想出来一句话：“小胡，你为什么待我这么好？”
pairs.en: Only then did Wang find something to say. “Young Hu, why are you so good to me?”

pairs.source_zh: “朋友嘛！”小胡答道，
pairs.source_en: “Because we're friends!” Young Hu replied.
pairs.zh: “朋友嘛！”小胡答道，
pairs.en: “Because we're friends!” Young Hu replied.

pairs.source_zh: “我看你好比虎落平阳，英雄末路，心里说不出的难过，
pairs.source_en: “Seeing you like this—a tiger stranded on the plain, a hero with nowhere to turn—makes me more miserable than I can say.
pairs.zh: “我看你好比虎落平阳，英雄末路，心里说不出的难过，
pairs.en: “Seeing you like this—a tiger stranded on the plain, a hero with nowhere to turn—makes me more miserable than I can say.

pairs.source_zh: 一定要拉你一把，才睡得着觉。”
pairs.source_en: I couldn't sleep unless I gave you a hand.”
pairs.zh: 一定要拉你一把，才睡得着觉。”
pairs.en: I couldn't sleep unless I gave you a hand.”

pairs.source_zh: “唉！”王有龄毕竟忍不住了，
pairs.source_en: “Ah!” Wang could hold back no longer.
pairs.zh: “唉！”王有龄毕竟忍不住了，
pairs.en: “Ah!” Wang could hold back no longer.

pairs.source_zh: 两行热泪，牵连不断。
pairs.source_en: Tears streamed down his face.
pairs.zh: 两行热泪，牵连不断。
pairs.en: Tears streamed down his face.

pairs.source_zh: “何必，何必？
pairs.source_en: “Come now, come now!
pairs.zh: “何必，何必？
pairs.en: “Come now, come now!

pairs.source_zh: 这不是大丈夫气概！”
pairs.source_en: Where's your courage?”
pairs.zh: 这不是大丈夫气概！”
pairs.en: Where's your courage?”

pairs.source_zh: 这句话是很好的安慰，也是很好的激励、
pairs.source_en: The words comforted him and restored his spirits.
pairs.zh: 这句话是很好的安慰，也是很好的激励、
pairs.en: The words comforted him and restored his spirits.

pairs.source_zh: 王有龄收拾涕泪，定一定神，
pairs.source_en: Wang wiped his tears away and composed himself.
pairs.zh: 王有龄收拾涕泪，定一定神，
pairs.en: Wang wiped his tears away and composed himself.

pairs.source_zh: 才想起一件事，相交至今，受人绝大的恩惠，却是对他的名氏、身世，一无所知，
pairs.source_en: Only then did something occur to him: he had received an immense kindness from a man whose full name and background he did not even know.
pairs.zh: 才想起一件事，相交至今，受人绝大的恩惠，却是对他的名氏、身世，一无所知，
pairs.en: Only then did something occur to him: he had received an immense kindness from a man whose full name and background he did not even know.

pairs.source_zh: 岂不荒唐？
pairs.source_en: How absurd!
pairs.zh: 岂不荒唐？
pairs.en: How absurd!

pairs.source_zh: 于是他微有窘色地问道：“小胡，还没有请教台甫？”
pairs.source_en: Slightly embarrassed, he asked, “Young Hu, I haven't yet had the honour of learning your courtesy name.”
pairs.zh: 于是他微有窘色地问道：“小胡，还没有请教台甫？”
pairs.en: Slightly embarrassed, he asked, “Young Hu, I haven't yet had the honour of learning your courtesy name.”

pairs.source_zh: “我叫胡光墉，字雪岩，
pairs.source_en: “My name is Hu Guangyong, and my courtesy name is Xueyan.
pairs.zh: “我叫胡光墉，字雪岩，
pairs.en: “My name is Hu Guangyong, and my courtesy name is Xueyan.

pairs.source_zh: 你呢，你的大号叫什么？”
pairs.source_en: What about yours?”
pairs.zh: 你呢，你的大号叫什么？”
pairs.en: What about yours?”

pairs.source_zh: “我叫雪轩。”
pairs.source_en: “Xuexuan.”
pairs.zh: “我叫雪轩。”
pairs.en: “Xuexuan.”

pairs.source_zh: “雪轩，雪岩！”胡雪岩自己念了两遍，抚掌笑道：“好极了，
pairs.source_en: “Xuexuan, Xueyan!” Hu repeated the names twice, then clapped his hands and laughed. “Splendid!
pairs.zh: “雪轩，雪岩！”胡雪岩自己念了两遍，抚掌笑道：“好极了，
pairs.en: “Xuexuan, Xueyan!” Hu repeated the names twice, then clapped his hands and laughed. “Splendid!

pairs.source_zh: 声音很近，好象一个人。
pairs.source_en: They sound so alike we might almost be the same person.
pairs.zh: 声音很近，好象一个人。
pairs.en: They sound so alike we might almost be the same person.

pairs.source_zh: 你叫我雪岩，我叫你雪轩。”
pairs.source_en: You call me Xueyan, and I'll call you Xuexuan.”
pairs.zh: 你叫我雪岩，我叫你雪轩。”
pairs.en: You call me Xueyan, and I'll call you Xuexuan.”

pairs.source_zh: “是，是！
pairs.source_en: “Yes, yes!
pairs.zh: “是，是！
pairs.en: “Yes, yes!

pairs.source_zh: 雪岩，我还要请教你，
pairs.source_en: Xueyan, there's something else I'd like to ask.
pairs.zh: 雪岩，我还要请教你，
pairs.en: Xueyan, there's something else I'd like to ask.

pairs.source_zh: 府上……”
pairs.source_en: Your family...”
pairs.zh: 府上……”
pairs.en: Your family...”

pairs.source_zh: 这是问他的家世，胡雪岩笑笑不肯多说：
pairs.source_en: He was asking about Hu's background, but Hu merely smiled and declined to say much.
pairs.zh: 这是问他的家世，胡雪岩笑笑不肯多说：
pairs.en: He was asking about Hu's background, but Hu merely smiled and declined to say much.

pairs.source_zh: “守一点薄产过日了，
pairs.source_en: “I live on a little property.
pairs.zh: “守一点薄产过日了，
pairs.en: “I live on a little property.

pairs.source_zh: 没有什么谈头。
pairs.source_en: There's nothing worth mentioning.
pairs.zh: 没有什么谈头。
pairs.en: There's nothing worth mentioning.

pairs.source_zh: 雪轩，我问你，你几时动身？”
pairs.source_en: Tell me, Xuexuan, when will you leave?”
pairs.zh: 雪轩，我问你，你几时动身？”
pairs.en: Tell me, Xuexuan, when will you leave?”

pairs.source_zh: “我不敢耽搁。
pairs.source_en: “I dare not delay.
pairs.zh: “我不敢耽搁。
pairs.en: “I dare not delay.

pairs.source_zh: 把舍间咯略安排一番，总在三、五日内就动身。
pairs.source_en: Once I've put things in order at home, I'll set off within three to five days.
pairs.zh: 把舍间咯略安排一番，总在三、五日内就动身。
pairs.en: Once I've put things in order at home, I'll set off within three to five days.

pairs.source_zh: 如果一切顺利，年底就可以回来。
pairs.source_en: If all goes well, I should be back by the end of the year.
pairs.zh: 如果一切顺利，年底就可以回来。
pairs.en: If all goes well, I should be back by the end of the year.

pairs.source_zh: 雪岩，我一定要走路子，分发到浙江来，你我弟兄好在一起。”
pairs.source_en: Xueyan, I'll do everything I can to secure an assignment to Zhejiang, so that we two brothers can be together.”
pairs.zh: 雪岩，我一定要走路子，分发到浙江来，你我弟兄好在一起。”
pairs.en: Xueyan, I'll do everything I can to secure an assignment to Zhejiang, so that we two brothers can be together.”

pairs.source_zh: “好极了。”
pairs.source_en: “Splendid!”
pairs.zh: “好极了。”
pairs.en: “Splendid!”

pairs.source_zh: 胡雪岩的“好极了”，已成口头禅，
pairs.source_en: The word was already becoming Hu's habitual response.
pairs.zh: 胡雪岩的“好极了”，已成口头禅，
pairs.en: The word was already becoming Hu's habitual response.

pairs.source_zh: “后天我们仍旧在这里会面，
pairs.source_en: “Let's meet here again the day after tomorrow.
pairs.zh: “后天我们仍旧在这里会面，
pairs.en: “Let's meet here again the day after tomorrow.

pairs.source_zh: 我给你饯行。”
pairs.source_en: I'll give you a farewell dinner.”
pairs.zh: 我给你饯行。”
pairs.en: I'll give you a farewell dinner.”

pairs.source_zh: “我一定来。”
pairs.source_en: “I'll certainly come.”
pairs.zh: “我一定来。”
pairs.en: “I'll certainly come.”

pairs.source_zh: 到了第三天，王有龄午饭刚过，就来赴约。
pairs.source_en: On the appointed day, Wang came just after lunch.
pairs.zh: 到了第三天，王有龄午饭刚过，就来赴约。
pairs.en: On the appointed day, Wang came just after lunch.

pairs.source_zh: 他穿了估衣铺买的直罗长衫，亮纱马褂，手里拿一柄“舒莲记”有名的“杭扇”，
pairs.source_en: He wore a gauze gown and a glossy gauze riding jacket bought at a second-hand clothes shop, and carried one of the famous Hangzhou folding fans made by Shulianji.
pairs.zh: 他穿了估衣铺买的直罗长衫，亮纱马褂，手里拿一柄“舒莲记”有名的“杭扇”，
pairs.en: He wore a gauze gown and a glossy gauze riding jacket bought at a second-hand clothes shop, and carried one of the famous Hangzhou folding fans made by Shulianji.

pairs.source_zh: 泡着茶等，
pairs.source_en: He ordered tea and waited.
pairs.zh: 泡着茶等，
pairs.en: He ordered tea and waited.

pairs.source_zh: 等到夭黑不见胡雪岩的踪影，
pairs.source_en: Darkness fell without any sign of Hu.
pairs.zh: 等到夭黑不见胡雪岩的踪影，
pairs.en: Darkness fell without any sign of Hu.

pairs.source_zh: 寻亦没处寻，只好再等。
pairs.source_en: There was nowhere he could go to look for him, so he could only keep waiting.
pairs.zh: 寻亦没处寻，只好再等。
pairs.en: There was nowhere he could go to look for him, so he could only keep waiting.

pairs.source_zh: 天气热了，城隍山上来品茗纳凉的，络绎不绝。
pairs.source_en: The weather had grown hot, and a steady stream of people came up City God Hill to drink tea and enjoy the cool air.
pairs.zh: 天气热了，城隍山上来品茗纳凉的，络绎不绝。
pairs.en: The weather had grown hot, and a steady stream of people came up City God Hill to drink tea and enjoy the cool air.

pairs.source_zh: 王有龄目迎目送着每一个行人，把脖子都摆得酸了，就是盼不着胡雪岩。
pairs.source_en: Wang watched every arrival and departure until his neck ached, but the man he hoped to see never appeared.
pairs.zh: 王有龄目迎目送着每一个行人，把脖子都摆得酸了，就是盼不着胡雪岩。
pairs.en: Wang watched every arrival and departure until his neck ached, but the man he hoped to see never appeared.

pairs.source_zh: 夜深客散，茶店收摊子，这下才把王有龄撵走。
pairs.source_en: Late at night, when the customers had gone and the teahouse was closing, Wang finally had to leave.
pairs.zh: 夜深客散，茶店收摊子，这下才把王有龄撵走。
pairs.en: Late at night, when the customers had gone and the teahouse was closing, Wang finally had to leave.

pairs.source_zh: 他已经雇好了船，无法不定，
pairs.source_en: He had already hired a boat and could not cancel his departure.
pairs.zh: 他已经雇好了船，无法不定，
pairs.en: He had already hired a boat and could not cancel his departure.

pairs.source_zh: 第二天五更时分上船，竟不能与胡雪岩见一面话别。
pairs.source_en: He boarded in the hours before dawn the next morning, without having had a chance to see Hu and say goodbye.
pairs.zh: 第二天五更时分上船，竟不能与胡雪岩见一面话别。
pairs.en: He boarded in the hours before dawn the next morning, without having had a chance to see Hu and say goodbye.

pairs.source_zh: 在王有龄北上不久，浙江的政局有了变化：
pairs.source_en: Shortly after Wang left for the north, Zhejiang's provincial administration changed.
pairs.zh: 在王有龄北上不久，浙江的政局有了变化：
pairs.en: Shortly after Wang left for the north, Zhejiang's provincial administration changed.

pairs.source_zh: 巡抚常大淳调湖北，云南巡抚黄宗汉改调浙江，
pairs.source_en: Governor Chang Dachun was transferred to Hubei, and Huang Zonghan, governor of Yunnan, was reassigned to Zhejiang.
pairs.zh: 巡抚常大淳调湖北，云南巡抚黄宗汉改调浙江，
pairs.en: Governor Chang Dachun was transferred to Hubei, and Huang Zonghan, governor of Yunnan, was reassigned to Zhejiang.

pairs.source_zh: 未到任以前由布政使——通称“藩司”、老百姓尊称为“藩台”的旗人椿寿署理。
pairs.source_en: Until Huang arrived, the acting governorship was held by Chunshou, a bannerman serving as provincial treasurer—a post commonly called fansi and respectfully referred to by ordinary people as fantai.
pairs.zh: 未到任以前由布政使——通称“藩司”、老百姓尊称为“藩台”的旗人椿寿署理。
pairs.en: Until Huang arrived, the acting governorship was held by Chunshou, a bannerman serving as provincial treasurer—a post commonly called fansi and respectfully referred to by ordinary people as fantai.

pairs.source_zh: 黄宗汉字寿臣，福建晋江人。
pairs.source_en: Huang Zonghan, whose courtesy name was Shouchen, came from Jinjiang in Fujian.
pairs.zh: 黄宗汉字寿臣，福建晋江人。
pairs.en: Huang Zonghan, whose courtesy name was Shouchen, came from Jinjiang in Fujian.

pairs.source_zh: 他是道光十五年乙未正科的翰林，
pairs.source_en: He had entered the Hanlin Academy after passing the regular metropolitan examination in the fifteenth year of the Daoguang reign, the yiwei year.
pairs.zh: 他是道光十五年乙未正科的翰林，
pairs.en: He had entered the Hanlin Academy after passing the regular metropolitan examination in the fifteenth year of the Daoguang reign, the yiwei year.

pairs.source_zh: 这一榜人才济济，科运甚隆，
pairs.source_en: That examination produced a remarkable crop of talented men whose careers prospered.
pairs.zh: 这一榜人才济济，科运甚隆，
pairs.en: That examination produced a remarkable crop of talented men whose careers prospered.

pairs.source_zh: 那年，咸丰二年，当到巡抚的就有三个，广东叶名琛、江西张芾，
pairs.source_en: By the year in question, the second year of Xianfeng, three had become provincial governors: Huang himself, Ye Mingchen in Guangdong, and Zhang Fu in Jiangxi.
pairs.zh: 那年，咸丰二年，当到巡抚的就有三个，广东叶名琛、江西张芾，
pairs.en: By the year in question, the second year of Xianfeng, three had become provincial governors: Huang himself, Ye Mingchen in Guangdong, and Zhang Fu in Jiangxi.

pairs.source_zh: 当到二品大员的有何桂清、吕贤基、彭蕴章、罗惇衍，
pairs.source_en: Others who had reached the second official rank included He Guiqing, Lü Xianji, Peng Yunzhang, and Luo Dunyan.
pairs.zh: 当到二品大员的有何桂清、吕贤基、彭蕴章、罗惇衍，
pairs.en: Others who had reached the second official rank included He Guiqing, Lü Xianji, Peng Yunzhang, and Luo Dunyan.

pairs.source_zh: 还有杭州的许乃钊，与他老兄许乃普，都当内阁学士。
pairs.source_en: Xu Naizhao of Hangzhou and his elder brother Xu Naipu had both become grand secretariat academicians.
pairs.zh: 还有杭州的许乃钊，与他老兄许乃普，都当内阁学士。
pairs.en: Xu Naizhao of Hangzhou and his elder brother Xu Naipu had both become grand secretariat academicians.

pairs.source_zh: 这黄宗汉据说是个很能干的人，但是关于他的操守与治家，批评极坏。
pairs.source_en: Huang was said to be highly capable, but his personal integrity and the management of his household were subjects of severe criticism.
pairs.zh: 这黄宗汉据说是个很能干的人，但是关于他的操守与治家，批评极坏。
pairs.en: Huang was said to be highly capable, but his personal integrity and the management of his household were subjects of severe criticism.

pairs.source_zh: 到任以后，传说他向椿寿索贿四万两银子，
pairs.source_en: After taking office, he was said to have demanded a bribe of forty thousand taels from Chunshou.
pairs.zh: 到任以后，传说他向椿寿索贿四万两银子，
pairs.en: After taking office, he was said to have demanded a bribe of forty thousand taels from Chunshou.

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿没有买他的帐，于是多事了。
pairs.source_en: Chunshou ignored the demand, and trouble followed.
pairs.zh: 椿寿没有买他的帐，于是多事了。
pairs.en: Chunshou ignored the demand, and trouble followed.

pairs.source_zh: 其时漕运正在改变办法。
pairs.source_en: At the time, the system for transporting the grain tax was undergoing change.
pairs.zh: 其时漕运正在改变办法。
pairs.en: At the time, the system for transporting the grain tax was undergoing change.

pairs.source_zh: 因为海禁已开，而且河道湮淤，加以洪杨的起事，
pairs.source_en: Maritime restrictions had been lifted, river channels were silting up, and the rebellion led by Hong Xiuquan and Yang Xiuqing had broken out.
pairs.zh: 因为海禁已开，而且河道湮淤，加以洪杨的起事，
pairs.en: Maritime restrictions had been lifted, river channels were silting up, and the rebellion led by Hong Xiuquan and Yang Xiuqing had broken out.

pairs.source_zh: 所以江苏的苏、松、太各属改用海运，浙江则是试办，
pairs.source_en: The jurisdictions of Suzhou, Songjiang, and Taicang in Jiangsu therefore switched to sea transport, while Zhejiang was preparing to try it.
pairs.zh: 所以江苏的苏、松、太各属改用海运，浙江则是试办，
pairs.en: The jurisdictions of Suzhou, Songjiang, and Taicang in Jiangsu therefore switched to sea transport, while Zhejiang was preparing to try it.

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿既为藩司，又署理巡抚，责无旁贷，
pairs.source_en: As both provincial treasurer and acting governor, Chunshou could not evade responsibility.
pairs.zh: 椿寿既为藩司，又署理巡抚，责无旁贷，
pairs.en: As both provincial treasurer and acting governor, Chunshou could not evade responsibility.

pairs.source_zh: 当然要亲自料理这件公事。
pairs.source_en: He had to oversee the matter personally.
pairs.zh: 当然要亲自料理这件公事。
pairs.en: He had to oversee the matter personally.

pairs.source_zh: 漕运的漕，原来就是以舟运谷的意思。
pairs.source_en: The word cao in caoyun, the grain-tax transport system, originally meant carrying grain by boat.
pairs.zh: 漕运的漕，原来就是以舟运谷的意思。
pairs.en: The word cao in caoyun, the grain-tax transport system, originally meant carrying grain by boat.

pairs.source_zh: 多少年来都是河运，先是黄河，后来是运河，
pairs.source_en: For centuries the grain had travelled by river, first on the Yellow River and later on the Grand Canal.
pairs.zh: 多少年来都是河运，先是黄河，后来是运河，
pairs.en: For centuries the grain had travelled by river, first on the Yellow River and later on the Grand Canal.

pairs.source_zh: 而运河又有多少次的变迁兴作，
pairs.source_en: The canal itself had undergone repeated changes and construction.
pairs.zh: 而运河又有多少次的变迁兴作，
pairs.en: The canal itself had undergone repeated changes and construction.

pairs.source_zh: 直到康熙年间，治河名臣靳辅，于成龙先后开“中河”，历时千余年的运河，才算大功告成。
pairs.source_en: Only during the Kangxi reign, when the celebrated river administrators Jin Fu and Yu Chenglong successively opened sections of the Middle Canal, was this waterway, more than a thousand years in the making, finally considered complete.
pairs.zh: 直到康熙年间，治河名臣靳辅，于成龙先后开“中河”，历时千余年的运河，才算大功告成。
pairs.en: Only during the Kangxi reign, when the celebrated river administrators Jin Fu and Yu Chenglong successively opened sections of the Middle Canal, was this waterway, more than a thousand years in the making, finally considered complete.

pairs.source_zh: 这条南起杭州，北抵京师，流经浙江、江苏、山东、河北四省，全长两千多里的水道，为大清朝带来了一百五十年的盛运。
pairs.source_en: Running from Hangzhou in the south to the capital in the north, through Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Shandong, and Hebei, the waterway extended for more than two thousand li and had brought the Qing dynasty a century and a half of prosperity.
pairs.zh: 这条南起杭州，北抵京师，流经浙江、江苏、山东、河北四省，全长两千多里的水道，为大清朝带来了一百五十年的盛运。
pairs.en: Running from Hangzhou in the south to the capital in the north, through Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Shandong, and Hebei, the waterway extended for more than two thousand li and had brought the Qing dynasty a century and a half of prosperity.

pairs.source_zh: 不幸的是，黄河的情况，越来越坏，
pairs.source_en: Unfortunately, conditions on the Yellow River grew steadily worse.
pairs.zh: 不幸的是，黄河的情况，越来越坏，
pairs.en: Unfortunately, conditions on the Yellow River grew steadily worse.

pairs.source_zh: 有些地方，河底积淤，高过人家屋脊，全靠两面堤防约束，
pairs.source_en: In places, accumulated silt raised its bed above the rooftops of nearby houses, leaving the river confined only by the embankments on either side.
pairs.zh: 有些地方，河底积淤，高过人家屋脊，全靠两面堤防约束，
pairs.en: In places, accumulated silt raised its bed above the rooftops of nearby houses, leaving the river confined only by the embankments on either side.

pairs.source_zh: “春水船如天上行”，真到了束手无策的地步。
pairs.source_en: “On spring waters, boats seem to sail through the sky”: matters had truly reached the point where no remedy seemed possible.
pairs.zh: “春水船如天上行”，真到了束手无策的地步。
pairs.en: “On spring waters, boats seem to sail through the sky”: matters had truly reached the point where no remedy seemed possible.

pairs.source_zh: 而运河受黄河的累，在嘉庆末年，几乎也成了“绝症”。
pairs.source_en: Burdened by the Yellow River's troubles, the Grand Canal itself was almost beyond cure by the end of the Jiaqing reign.
pairs.zh: 而运河受黄河的累，在嘉庆末年，几乎也成了“绝症”。
pairs.en: Burdened by the Yellow River's troubles, the Grand Canal itself was almost beyond cure by the end of the Jiaqing reign.

pairs.source_zh: 于是道光初年有海运之议。
pairs.source_en: Hence the proposal, early in the Daoguang reign, to ship the grain by sea.
pairs.zh: 于是道光初年有海运之议。
pairs.en: Hence the proposal, early in the Daoguang reign, to ship the grain by sea.
